name: Compression Quality Prediction
subtitle: DeepCQ and QualityNet
description: We develop deep surrogate models that estimate the quality of scientific lossy compression and support informed configuration choices. QualityNet studies error-bounded compression quality prediction. DeepCQ extends this direction with a modular two-stage framework that reuses extracted features across compressors, quality metrics, and scientific datasets.
summary: Deep surrogate models predict scientific compression quality and help select compressors and error bounds.
